item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 26/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring hot weather to the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, showers will continue to affect the region. The area of low pressure now over seas east of the Philippines will move across the vicinity of Luzon tomorrow. Upper-air disturbances associated with the area of low pressure will affect the coast of southeastern China midweek this week. The weather will be unsettled over the region. A southwesterly airstream will bring showers to the coast of Guangdong over the weekend to early next week.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Showers will be heavier in some areas with thunderstorms at first. Hot with sunny periods during the day.
